title: No identity feature sets a type's level; the chain overhaul began
set_out: Finish each cell type's own level (A8) and test the identity pattern and islands meter; bring the book up to date at a high level; overhaul the chain so it acts as one instrument; carry IAM's Law forward on IAM's web.
open_at_turnover: The second laboratory at full depth; the full-depth mixture; the Met-A held-site check; routing (overhaul 2b); each type's position in the chain; the rehearsal; the location test and rates by type.

entries.outcome: The headline reads the mixture as one cell type: routing to be fixed. The 10 M plant was too thin to judge shares.
